description.fun: Dhelmise isn't really the anchor and ship's wheel it looks like: its true body is the seaweed holding the wreckage together. It hunts big prey like Wailord, knocking them out with one swing of its anchor, then wrapping them in seaweed that stretches hundreds of yards and draining their life force. It patches itself up with fresh seaweed and junk, and it gets on well with Skrelp and Dragalge.
description.guide: Dhelmise is a Ghost- and Grass-type Pokémon from Alola: a mass of seaweed holding together a ship's anchor and wheel. It swings its anchor to knock out large prey and drains their energy. It may draw on ghost-ship legends such as the Flying Dutchman.
description.tagline: A haunted shipwreck anchor that hunts whales
